lead: Real data from matches played: % over/under, both teams to score, clean sheets, half-time, corners and cards, overall, at home, away or over the last 5 matches. Click a column header to sort by that column (click again to reverse the order).

legend: # = position in the standings for the chosen view · P = played · W/D/L = won/drawn/lost · GF/GA/GD = goals for/against/difference · Form: W/D/L over the last 5 matches, most recent on the right. On narrow screens some columns are hidden; on a computer you'll see them all. Half-time, corners and cards are calculated only from matches that include that data. With fewer than {{n}} matches (in grey, without heat map) the percentages are unreliable — treat them as a rough guide, not as an established pattern.
